QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] Something Moist
QuestInfo.0: You must stop whatever evil is afoot on the White Heaven. Be sure to check each room.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the Pixies and water monsters, collect the Rain Drops, and then drain all their water. Just in case.
QuestInfo.2: You sure shut those adorable critters down.

item.0: Please, we can't let Orbis flood! No one in Orbis knows how to swim!
